profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Bloomberg | Ex Amazon
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Senior Fullstack Software Engineer at Bloomberg. 
Previously software engineer at Amazon, and Computer Science graduate from the University of Michigan 2019

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Lead engineer on Bloomberg's internal unified approvals system
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Docker · Systems Design · Large Scale Deployments

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Developed core pages and features of Amazon's centralized internal security management platform with 50,000+ monthly users. Designed and built the exceptions management workflow, and the security rules onboarding process used to standardize and streamline hundreds of security campaigns to reach and secure all of Amazon internal products
positions.insights: Skills: Unix · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.description: Developed a tool for controlled, partial website traffic routing to different back-end servers within Amazon. I implemented custom routing rules to reroute web traffic requests to backend servers to lower latency on network traffic, and developed a frontend user interface in React.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: Developed a web application for students in select Freshman Engineering courses that can provide live-time presentation feedback on the effectiveness of the presenter. This full-stack application incorporates Python, JavaScript frameworks for front-end and SQL databases for back-end storage. The app collects aggregate data from classmates and reports it in real time to the presenter

company.name: University of Michigan College of Engineering

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed and tested new configurations of materials to be used in dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs), a cheaper alternative solar cell technology to traditional silicon based solar cells, that could improve energy conversion efficiency. I used a Cobalt based organic solution for redox purposes and a Ruthenium based dye to further reduce back recombinations of electrons in the electron transfer process of DSSCs for a more efficient energy conversion

company.name: Michigan State University Hamann Research Group

honors.title: Dean's Honor List
honors.description: Made the Dean's Honor list of the College of Engineering at the University of Michigan for the Winter 2015 term with a GPA greater than 3.50
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Michigan College of Engineering · Jan 2015

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentoring local undergraduate students within AANHPI on career goals, and preparing for industry demands as a software engineer or similar fields. I meet with various mentees once a week for personalized coaching/mentoring sessions, and bridge students with career insights, events, and opportunities regularly.

As a fourth degree black belt/master, I led and taught weekly practices at the University of Washington's Taekwondo Club for students. I plan lessons, cater instructions to every individual, and lead practices of 10-30 students to increase physical fitness, teach fundamentals and high level strategy for sparring, and coach whitebelts to blackbelts in sparring on a weekly basis.

organizations.name: Stockwell Hall Programming Board
organizations.description:
As president of the Stockwell Hall Programming Board, I organized and led affairs for weekly meetings to obtain and allocate funding for a variety of events for the residents of Stockwell. 
Presidential duties include: creating agendas for meetings, conducting business transactions with outside organizations for payment, and overseeing operations for the smooth operations of our committee
